summary: Interactive romantic-themed Valentine proposal web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with playful Yes/No interaction and a meme image on acceptance, designed to run on Android Chrome.
architectural_notes: Implement as a single self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS/JS for easy running on Android Chrome.
Use mousemove/mouseover/touch handling to reposition the 'No' button to avoid selection while keeping layout responsive.
Include a meme image asset (embedded as base64 or referenced locally) and display it conditionally after 'Yes' click.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Romantic meme-style image with the caption "Good choice" integrated in the image (valentine-meme-good-choice.dim_1024x1024.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page romantic Valentine proposal experience in the frontend that asks: "Will you be my Valentine?" with two options: "Yes" and "No", using a consistent pink-and-white theme.

Implement playful interaction where the "No" button evades user interaction: when the user attempts to hover over or touch the "No" button, it moves to a new random position within a bounded container so it cannot be clicked.
When the user clicks/taps "Yes", transition to an acceptance state that displays a meme image and the text: "Good choice" (exact capitalization).
Ensure the page is fully interactive with client-side logic only and requires no backend canister functionality to operate.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a simple romantic Valentine proposal web page with Yes/No buttons; 'No' button evades cursor hover to prevent clicking; clicking 'Yes' shows a meme image with the text 'good choice'; pink/white theme; runnable in Android Chrome.

projectName: Romantic Valentine proposal page with evasive No button and meme on Yes
